data.title: 因幡巡 · 旧书架上的隐藏关卡
data.description: 巡在旧书店找到一本绝版攻略。她用指腹托住松动的书脊，小声念出以前卡住自己的关卡名，连笑容都放轻了。
data.promptProse: In a quiet used bookstore, Meguru wears an oatmeal knit pullover and teal corduroy pinafore. She supports the worn spine of a game guide with both hands while reading a familiar chapter, smiling to herself. Warm ceiling lights illuminate the narrow wooden shelves.
data.animaCaption: Both hands support the old book without pulling its loose cover apart.
data.action: 托着旧书书脊阅读攻略
